post.title: Over half of US stocks lost money. Index fund vs picks
post.ig:
Over half of US stocks since 1926 lost money.

Bessembinder's study of about 29,000 US stocks (1926-2023): 51.6% had negative lifetime returns, and about 4% created all the market's gains above Treasury bills.
In 2025, a narrow year, only 30.5% of S&P 500 stocks beat the index (First Trust).
Index funds own the winners and the losers. Single stocks can beat the index, or hit zero.

Sources: Hendrik Bessembinder (1926-2023), First Trust (Jan 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
